description: Evaluation clips. Every source is public domain or Creative Commons and was checked against its archive.org / blender.org listing on 2026-11-18. Media is processed locally for research and never redistributed; only annotations, timestamps and these URLs are published. Segments were chosen from the listings without viewing -- if a segment turns out to hold little dialogue, adjust start/end before labelling, never after.
